note: The layers the viewer can draw: each maps a record a run saved, or a number worked out from saved ones by a declared rule, to a mark. A record is named as a run's view names it: the engine's own readout name, or the name an adapter gave it, in the order tried. Where a layer lists several quantities (first_of), it takes the first the run can feed: the engine's own readout where the run kept it, a worked-out number otherwise. A rule with several inputs names, for each part it is worked out from, what may fill it, in the order tried: a record the run saved, a named constant of its definition (stated by the run's view only where nothing the run schedules changes it), or an amount over a volume. A rate may be worked out from every one of several saved totals (any_of): each total the run saved is read, and a total saved once for each species is read for every species. A layer may ask for the run's secreted species (species: secreted). A layer is offered for a run only when the run saved what it needs; what a run did not save is said. A record laid over the cells that no layer here names is still offered as a colouring and a relief, under the record's own name. A layer that says `opens` is on as a run opens, where the run can feed it.

layers.label: Membrane voltage
layers.says: Each cell is coloured by its membrane voltage.

layers.label: Membrane voltage
layers.says: Each cell stands as high as its membrane voltage. Nothing is smoothed between cells.

layers.label: Voltage drops

also.says: A hollow wedge: the junction's gate is under half open.
also.without: This run did not save each junction's gate, so every wedge is drawn solid.

also.says: Two bars: the two cells differ in voltage, and no junction has formed between them.
also.without: This run did not save how far each junction has formed, so a wedge is drawn wherever the voltages differ.

layers.says: A wedge on a junction points down the voltage drop across it, and is as wide as the drop is large. It is a difference of voltages, not a current: it never moves.

layers.label: Push and pull on ions
layers.says: For each ion at the chosen cell's membrane: the push of its concentration difference, the pull of the voltage, and what is left of the two, in millivolts. An arrow is a drive, not a flow: it never moves.

layers.label: Membrane charge
layers.says: Plus and minus marks at the two faces of the chosen cell's membrane, as many as the charge its voltage stands for on a piece of that size. How many there are is worked out; where each sits is illustration.

layers.label: Transfers
layers.says: Beads cross from one place to the next (between two cells through their junction, between a cell and the space outside it, between two spaces outside), as many a second as the run's saved totals grew between two records. A bead is a token of a rate, not a particle: the legend says how much one stands for and what time the picture keeps.

layers.label: Ion traffic

also.says: Beads through the pump: its cycles between two records, times the ions one cycle moves as the pump's declaration gives them.
also.without: This run did not save its pumps' cycles, so no beads cross through a pump.

also.says: Beads through the membrane itself: what its own passive routes carried, beside its channel populations and its pump.
also.without: This run did not save what crossed the membrane itself, beside its channel populations and its pump.

layers.says: Beads cross the chosen cell's membrane through each of its channel populations, through its pump and through the membrane itself, as many a second as the run's saved totals grew between two records. A bead is a token of a rate, not an ion: the legend says how many ions one stands for and what time the picture keeps.

layers.label: Energy dissipated

also.says: A glowing spot on a cell: what the pump of its membrane dissipated.
also.without: This run did not save what its pumps dissipated.

also.says: A glowing spot on a cell for each of its channel populations: what it dissipated.
also.without: This run did not save what its channel populations dissipated.

layers.says: A glow where energy is dissipated: on a junction, on a face between two spaces outside, on a membrane. The brighter, the more a second, as the run's saved totals grew between two records. A magnitude with a scale, not a temperature.

layers.label: Secreted species

also.says: The spaces outside the cells are coloured too, on the same scale, by the amount in each.
also.without: This run did not save the amount in each space outside the cells, so only the cells are coloured.

also.says: What was made in each cell since the start is given with the cell's numbers.
also.without: This run did not save what was made in each cell.

also.says: What was cleared in each cell since the start is given with the cell's numbers.
also.without: This run did not save what was cleared in each cell.

also.says: What was cleared in each space outside since the start is given in the panel.
also.without: This run did not save what was cleared outside the cells.

layers.says: Each cell, and each space outside the cells that the picture gives a tile, is coloured by the amount of the secreted species in it. An amount, not a concentration: places differ in volume.
